preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 400,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i in the list a is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The total number of cells x in the beautiful rectangle is between 1 and n.
The product of the dimensions p and q equals the total number of cells x.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == q for row in rectangle)
postconditions.description: Each row in the rectangle has exactly q columns.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(row)) == q for row in rectangle)
postconditions.description: Each row in the rectangle contains all unique values.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(col)) == p for col in zip(*rectangle))
postconditions.description: Each column in the rectangle contains all unique values.

postconditions.expression: all(a_i in {cell for row in rectangle for cell in row} for a_i in a if a_i in {cell for row in rectangle for cell in row})
postconditions.description: All chosen numbers are present in the rectangle.
